verses.text: Of David. LORD, argue against those who argue against me. Fight against those who fight against me.
Pick up your shields, large and small, and come to help me.
Raise your spear and block the way of those who are chasing me. Say to me, "I am the one who saves you."
Let those who are trying to kill me be put to shame and disgraced. Let those who plan to ruin me be turned back in confusion.
Let them be like chaff blown by the wind, with the angel of the LORD driving them away.
Let their path be dark and slippery, with the angel of the LORD chasing them.
For no reason they hid their net for me in a pit. For no reason they dug a pit to trap me.
Let ruin come on them by surprise. Let the net they hid catch them. Let them fall into the ruin they planned.
Then I will be full of joy in the LORD. I will celebrate because he rescued me.
With my whole body I will say, "LORD, who is like you? You rescue the poor from those who are too strong for them. You rescue the poor and needy from those who rob them."
Lying witnesses rise up. They ask me about things I know nothing about.
They pay me back evil for good. I am left all alone.
But when they were sick, I wore rough clothes of sadness. I went without food to humble myself. My prayers went unanswered.
I acted as if they were my friends or brothers. I bowed my head in sadness, like someone crying for his mother.
But when I was in trouble, they gathered together and celebrated. Attackers I did not even know gathered against me. They kept tearing at me without stopping.
Like godless people mocking at a feast, they ground their teeth at me.
Lord, how long will you just watch? Rescue me from their attacks. Rescue my precious life from these lions.
Then I will thank you in front of the great crowd. I will praise you among many people.
Do not let my lying enemies celebrate over me. Do not let those who hate me for no reason wink at each other.
They do not talk about peace. Instead, they make up lies against the quiet people of the land.
They open their mouths wide against me and say, "Aha! Aha! We saw it with our own eyes!"
LORD, you have seen it. Do not stay silent. Lord, do not be far away from me.
Wake up! Get up and defend me, my God! My Lord, fight for my cause!
LORD my God, declare me innocent because you are fair. Do not let them celebrate over me.
Do not let them say to themselves, "Aha! This is just what we wanted!" Do not let them say, "We have swallowed him up!"
Let everyone who is happy about my trouble be put to shame and confused. Let those who make themselves great at my expense be covered with shame and disgrace.
Let those who want me to be proved right shout for joy and be glad. Let them always say, "The LORD is great! He is pleased when his servant does well!"
My tongue will talk about how you do what is right, and I will praise you all day long.
